scope: Bounded RC indoor optical and sensor effects

scenario.invariant: The simulation world, fixed initial chaser pose, calibrated mount, and camera projection remain unchanged. The pre-sensor capture advanced empty runtime frames during setup; only the resolved sensor pass differs visually.

sensor.implementation: One reusable WebGL render target and fullscreen shader pass per actor-view renderer. The deterministic simulation profile bypasses the pass.

determinism.result: Two RC indoor snapshots at the same frame and pose produced byte-identical PNGs with the same sensor metadata.

qualifiedEffects: Fixed radial barrel distortion: retained as a low-strength visual estimate of the physical wide-angle camera.
Fixed vignette: retained as a low-strength edge falloff that does not obscure the obstacles or floor.
rejectedEffects: Blur: no measured focus, motion, or shutter evidence.
Grain/noise: no exposure-series evidence and no deterministic physical noise model.
Compression: front-view evidence remains PNG so observations are not degraded by an artificial codec.
